Luck Potions: The '''Luck Potions''' are three types of [[buff potions]] which grant the [[Lucky (buff)|Lucky buff]], increasing the player's [[luck]]. {{buffduration|5–15 minutes}}
Lesser Mana Potion: The '''Lesser Mana Potion''' is a [[Recovery potions|recovery potion]] that restores {{iteminfo|Lesser Mana Potion|healMana}} [[mana]] when used and inflicts the [[Mana Sickness]] [[debuff]] upon use. It can be purchased from the [[Merchant]] for {{iteminfo|Lesser Mana Potion|buy}} each, and can also be found in [[Wooden Crate|Wooden]] and [[Pearlwood Crate]]s obtained from [[fishing]].
Ironskin Potion: The '''Ironskin Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] that grants the '''Ironskin''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the player's [[defense]] by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / {{expert|6}} / {{master|8}}. {{buffduration}}
Healing Potion: The '''Healing Potion''' is a [[pre-Hardmode]] [[recovery potion]] that restores 100 [[health]] and inflicts [[Potion Sickness]] for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the [[Philosopher's Stone]] or [[Charm of Myths]]. It is the second tier of healing potion, succeeding the [[Lesser Healing Potion]] and preceding the [[Greater Healing Potion]], [[Jungle Juice]] and [[Super Healing Potion]].
Battle Potion: The '''Battle Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Battle''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the [[NPC spawning|spawn rate]] and maximum number of [[enemies]] and [[critters]] that can be on-screen at once by 100%, effectively doubling these rates. {{buffduration}}
Lesser Healing Potion: The ''' Lesser Healing Potion''' is a [[pre-Hardmode]] [[recovery potion]] that restores 50 [[health]] and inflicts [[Potion Sickness]] for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the [[Philosopher's Stone]] or [[Charm of Myths]]. It is the first tier of healing potion, preceding the [[Healing Potion]], [[Greater Healing Potion]], [[Jungle Juice]] and [[Super Healing Potion]].
Regeneration Potion: The '''Regeneration Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Regeneration''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff provides [[health regeneration]] by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. {{buffduration}}
Spelunker Potion: The '''Spelunker Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Spelunker''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff illuminates valuable nearby objects and [[highlight]]s them with a yellow tint. {{buffduration}}
Swiftness Potion: The '''Swiftness Potion''' is a [[buff potion]] which grants the '''Swiftness''' [[buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum [[movement speed]] by 25%, but does not stack with [[sprinting accessories]] (such as [[Hermes Boots]]), nor does it affect the speed of [[mounts]]. {{buffduration}}
Mana Potion: The '''Mana Potion''' is a [[Recovery potions|recovery potion]] that restores 100 [[mana]] and inflicts the [[Mana Sickness]] [[debuff]] upon use. It can be crafted or occasionally obtained from any [[Crates]] except for [[Wooden Crate|Wooden]] and [[Pearlwood Crate]]s. They are also sold by the [[Merchant]] in [[Hardmode]] for {{iteminfo|Mana Potion|buy}}.
Fishing Potion: The '''Fishing Potion''' is a [[buff potion]] which grants the '''Fishing''' [[buff]] when consumed. The buff increases [[Fishing Power]] by 15. {{buffduration}}
Hunter Potion: The '''Hunter Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Hunter''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff shows the location of [[enemies]], [[critters]], and [[NPCs]] on the screen by [[highlight]]ing them in red (enemies) or green (critters and NPCs). Although these affected entities glow, they do not emit any light to the surrounding area. {{buffduration}}
Invisibility Potion: The '''Invisibility Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] that grants the '''Invisibility''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. {{buffduration}} The buff is furthermore immediately canceled if the player takes damage of any kind.
Obsidian Skin Potion: The '''Obsidian Skin Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Obsidian Skin''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff makes the player immune to [[lava]] and the [[On Fire!]] [[Debuffs|debuff]]. It also grants immunity to the [[Burning]] debuff from touching [[Meteorite]], [[Hellstone]], [[Hellstone Brick]]s, and [[Ancient Hellstone Brick]]s for its duration. {{buffduration}}
Builder Potion:
The '''Builder Potion''' is a [[buff potion]] that grants the '''Builder''' [[buff]] when consumed. It grants the following effects:
* +1 [[placement range]]
* +25% [[placement speed]] when placing [[blocks]] and [[walls]]
Summoning Potion: The '''Summoning Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Summoning''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the player's [[minion slots]] by 1. {{buffduration}}
Night Owl Potion: The '''Night Owl Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] that grants the '''Night Owl''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff improves the player's night vision, and sharply increases the radius of any available light source<!-- ACTUAL INCREASE % NEEDED, SEE DISCUSSION -->. The buff itself has no effect in total darkness. {{buffduration}}
Gills Potion: The '''Gills Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Gills''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff prevents the player's [[breath meter]] from depleting and thus prevents [[drowning]]. {{buffduration}}
Shine Potion: The '''Shine Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Shine''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed, causing the player to emit bright [[Light sources|light]]. {{buffduration}}
Rage Potion: The '''Rage Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Rage''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the player's [[Critical hit|critical strike chance]] by 10%. {{buffduration}}
Ammo Reservation Potion: The '''Ammo Reservation Potion''' is a [[buff potion]] which grants the '''Ammo Reservation''' [[buff]] when consumed. The buff reduces the [[Ammo conservation|chance of consuming any ammunition]] by 20%. {{buffduration}}
Wrath Potion: The '''Wrath Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Wrath''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the [[damage]] dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon [[weapons]] by 10%. {{buffduration}}
Mana Regeneration Potion: The '''Mana Regeneration Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Mana Regeneration''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the rate at which the player's [[mana]] regenerates. {{buffduration}}
Magic Power Potion: The '''Magic Power Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Magic Power''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases [[magic damage]] by 20%. {{buffduration}}
Archery Potion: The '''Archery Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Archery''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the [[damage]] of [[arrow]]-firing [[weapons]] by 10%, as well as the [[velocity]] of arrows by 20%. {{buffduration}}
Endurance Potion: The '''Endurance Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] that grants the '''Endurance''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed, which provides +10% [[damage reduction]]. {{buffduration}}
Warmth Potion: The '''Warmth Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] that grants the '''Warmth''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed, which provides +30% [[damage reduction]] from cold-themed [[enemies]] ''(see [[#Affected entities|below]])''. It also reduces the duration of [[Chilled]] by 75% and [[Frozen]] by 50%. {{buffduration}}
Lifeforce Potion: The ''' Lifeforce Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] that grants the '''Lifeforce''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the player's [[health]] capacity by up to 20% (see [[#Notes|below]] for details). {{buffduration}}
Super Healing Potion: The '''Super Healing Potion''' is a [[Hardmode]], post-[[Lunatic Cultist]] [[recovery potion]] that heals {{iteminfo|Super Healing Potion|healLife}} [[health]] and inflicts [[Potion Sickness]] for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the [[Philosopher's Stone]] or [[Charm of Myths]].
Dangersense Potion: The '''Dangersense Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Dangersense''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff reveals hazardous [[traps]], blocks, and objects that can potentially harm or impede the player by [[highlight]]ing them in red, even in complete darkness. {{buffduration}}
Titan Potion: The ''' Titan Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Titan''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the amount of [[knockback]] the player inflicts on [[enemies]] by 50%. {{buffduration}}
Heartreach Potion: The '''Heartreach Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Heartreach''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the [[pickup range]] of life recovery [[Heart]]s by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. {{buffduration}}
Flipper Potion: The '''Flipper Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Flipper''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff allows the player to move horizontally and vertically through [[water]], [[lava]], and [[honey]] without slowing down, and also allows the player to swim without equipping any swimming [[accessories]], such as the [[Flipper]]. {{buffduration}}
Sonar Potion: The '''Sonar Potion''' is a [[buff potion]] which grants the '''Sonar''' [[buff]] when consumed. The buff displays the name of a fishing catch above a [[Fishing poles|fishing pole]]'s bobber when it receives a bite while [[fishing]], along with a {{sound|[[:File:Sonar potion.wav|sound effect]]|Sonar potion.wav}}. {{buffduration}}
Water Walking Potion: The '''Water Walking Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Water Walking''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff allows the player to walk on the surface of all [[liquids]] ([[water]], [[lava]], [[honey]], and [[Shimmer]]), and prevents [[fall damage]] when falling onto liquid surfaces. The player can sink into liquids by pressing {{key|down}}. {{buffduration}}
Crate Potion: The '''Crate Potion''' is a [[buff potion]] which grants the '''Crate''' [[buff]] when consumed. The buff increases the chance of getting a [[crate]] from {{chance|1/10}} to {{chance|1/4}} when [[fishing]]. {{buffduration}}
Gravitation Potion: The '''Gravitation Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Gravitation''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff allows the player to invert [[gravity]] with {{key|up}}, making the screen appear upside-down and causing the player to fall upwards and walk on top of ceilings. The effect can be toggled while in midair. {{buffduration}}
Biome Sight Potion: The '''Biome Sight Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Biome Sight''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff [[highlight]]s all tiles that are infected with [[The Corruption]], [[The Crimson]], or [[The Hallow]] in purple, red, and pink respectively, while in the dark. {{buffduration}}
Super Mana Potion: The '''Super Mana Potion''' is a [[Hardmode]], post-[[Plantera]] [[Recovery potions|recovery potion]] that restores 400 [[mana]] and inflicts the [[Mana Sickness]] [[debuff]] upon use. It is the most potent of all mana restoration items.
Love Potion: The '''Love Potion''' is a [[Hardmode]] thrown [[potion]] that functions similarly to [[Thrown Water]]. Upon colliding with solid [[blocks]], it inflicts the '''Lovestruck''' [[debuff]] on players (including the user), [[enemies]], [[critters]], and [[NPCs]] within a radius of 9 tiles, causing them to emit red hearts for 30 seconds. It also increases affected NPCs' [[happiness]] by 10% for the duration of the effect.
Teleportation Potion: The '''Teleportation Potion''' is a [[potion]] that teleports the user to a random location. In addition to being crafted, it can be found in [[Chests#Cavern|Chests]] located in the [[Cavern]] [[Layers|layer]] and in [[Shadow Chest]]s.
Wormhole Potion: The '''Wormhole Potion''' is a [[potion]] which allows a player to instantly teleport to another team member's location in [[multiplayer]], done by selecting their player icon in the full-screen [[Minimap|map]] (accessible by pressing the {{key|map}} key) once consumed. It is only possible to teleport to players of the same [[team]], and the teleport will be announced in a [[status message]]. It is not possible to use Wormhole Potions if the player has the minimap disabled.
Gender Change Potion: The '''Gender Change Potion''' is a [[pre-Hardmode]] [[potion]] that allows the player to swap their [[Character styles|character style]] between male and female. Hurt sounds and equipment sprites change accordingly. The effect lasts until another Gender Change Potion is used.
Flask of Poison: The '''Flask of Poison''' is a [[flask]] that causes [[melee weapons]] and {{eil|whips}} to inflict the [[Poisoned]] [[debuff]] for 5–9 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire [[projectiles]] will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.
Restoration Potion: The '''Restoration Potion''' is a [[Recovery potions|recovery potion]] that can be found in [[Shadow Chest]]s in [[the Underworld]]. When used, it restores {{iteminfo|Restoration Potion|healLife}} [[health]] and inflicts [[Potion Sickness]] for only 45 seconds (rather than the usual 60 of health-restoring potions). The duration of Potion Sickness can be reduced to 33.75 seconds via the [[Philosopher's Stone]], [[Charm of Myths]] or [[Catalyst Band]].
Inferno Potion: The '''Inferno Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] that grants the '''Inferno''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff casts a spinning ring of fire around the player that deals 20 damage per second and inflicts the [[Hellfire]] [[Debuffs|debuff]] for 2 seconds to all [[enemies]] inside of it while also giving off light. [[Critters]] and other passive [[NPCs]] are unaffected. {{buffduration}}
Flask of Fire: The Flask of Fire cannot be used in conjunction with other flasks, and using it will remove any existing flask effects. Like all other flasks, the effect will not be canceled when the player [[death|dies]].
Recall Potion: The '''Recall Potion''' is a [[Potions|potion]] that will teleport the player to their [[spawn point]] {{duration|0.166666666|round=3}} (10 ticks){{tick}} after being used.{{source code ref|v=1.4.5.5|method=Terraria.Player.ItemCheck}} It is identical in function to a [[Magic Mirror]] or [[Ice Mirror]], but significantly faster in [[use time]].
Thorns Potion: The '''Thorns Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Thorns''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff inflicts a [[knockback]] of {{knockback|10|full=y|class=}} on [[enemies]] that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them.{{source code ref|v=1.4.3.6|method=Terraria.Player.Update_NPCCollision}} {{buffduration}}
Flask of Ichor: The '''Flask of Ichor''' is a [[Hardmode]] [[flask]] that causes [[melee weapons]] and [[whips]] to inflict the [[Ichor debuff]] for 10–19 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire [[projectiles]] will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.
Featherfall Potion: The '''Featherfall Potion''' is a [[Buff potions|buff potion]] which grants the '''Featherfall''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff negates [[fall damage]], and reduces the player's fall speed and [[gravity]] to {{chance|1/3}}{{source code ref|name=update|v=1.4.4.9|method=Terraria.Player.Update}} of normal, allowing them to jump higher and fall slower. {{buffduration}}
Flask of Venom: The '''Flask of Venom''' is a [[Hardmode]], post-[[Plantera]] [[flask]] that causes [[melee weapons]] and [[whips]] to inflict the [[Acid Venom]] [[debuff]] on hit for 5–9 seconds, as well as the [[Potent Acid]] debuff for 1 second. Melee weapons that fire [[projectiles]] will also inflict the debuffs on enemies hit by the projectiles.
Greater Healing Potion: The '''Greater Healing Potion''' is a [[Hardmode]] [[recovery potion]] that restores 150 [[health]] and inflicts [[Potion Sickness]] for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the [[Philosopher's Stone]] or [[Charm of Myths]].
Flask of Cursed Flames: The '''Flask of Cursed Flames''' is a [[Hardmode]] [[flask]] that causes [[melee weapons]] and {{eil|whips}} to inflict the [[Cursed Inferno]] [[debuff]] on hit for 3–6 seconds, which deals 24 damage per second and increases knockback on targets. Melee weapons that fire [[projectiles]] will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.
Greater Mana Potion: The '''Greater Mana Potion''' is a [[Hardmode]] [[Recovery potions|recovery potion]] that restores {{iteminfo|Greater Mana Potion|healMana}} [[mana]] and inflicts the [[Mana Sickness]] [[debuff]] upon use. Unlike most potions, Greater Mana Potions cannot be crafted, and are instead purchased from the [[Wizard]] for {{iteminfo|Greater Mana Potion|buy}}, or dropped from all [[Biome Mimics]] except the [[Jungle Mimic]].
Flask of Gold: The '''Flask of Gold''' is a [[Hardmode]] [[flask]] that causes [[melee weapons]] and {{eil|whips}} to inflict the [[Midas]] [[debuff]] for 2 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire [[projectiles]] will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.
Mining Potion: The '''Mining Potion''' is a [[buff potion]] which grants the '''Mining''' [[Buffs|buff]] when consumed. The buff increases [[mining speed]] by 25%. {{buffduration}}
Flask of Party: The '''Flask of Party''' is a [[flask]] that causes [[melee weapons]] and {{eil|whips}} to create bursts of confetti when hitting enemies. The confetti is purely cosmetic and does not provide damage bonuses. Melee weapons that fire [[projectiles]] will also create confetti when the projectiles hit enemies.
Potion of Return: The '''Potion of Return''' is a [[potion]] that teleports the player back to their [[spawn point]], similar to the [[Recall Potion]], and additionally creates a portal exit at the location where the potion was consumed. A portal entrance will be created at the spawn point, which can be used to teleport back to where the player consumed the potion. The portal can only be used once and will disappear afterwards. In addition to being crafted, the Potion of Return can be found in [[Pot]]s in the [[Cavern]] layer and [[the Underworld]], as well as in [[Shadow Chest]]s.
Red Potion: The '''Red Potion''' is a [[potion]] which can be found in [[chests]] within worlds generated with the [[Drunk]] seed enabled ({{chance|1/30}} chance), or the [[For the Worthy]] seed enabled ({{chance|1/10}} chance), or both Drunk and For the Worthy enabled ({{chance|13/100}} chance)<!-- 1-(29/30)*(9/10)-->.{{source code ref|v=1.4.5.6|method=Terraria.Worldgen.FinishDrunkGen / Terraria.Worldgen.FinishGetGoodWorld}} It can also be dropped by [[Jungle Mimic]]s, which spawn in [[Underground Jungle]] during [[Hardmode]] when [[Celebration Mk 10]] is enabled.{{source code ref|v=1.4.5.6|method=Terraria.NPC.SpawnAnNPC}}
Stink Potion: The '''Stink Potion''' is a thrown [[potion]] that functions similarly to [[Thrown Water]]s. Upon colliding with solid [[blocks]], it inflicts the [[Stinky]] [[debuff]] on players (including the user), [[enemies]], [[critters]], and [[NPCs]] within a radius of 9 tiles.
